title: Erlebnistherme Zillertal Fügen
highlights: Family-friendly adventure spa boasting a year-round heated outdoor brine pool
Western Austria's longest waterslide measuring 133 meters with built-in speed timing
Generous wave pool and lazy river current ensuring splashing aquatic fun
Exclusive wellness and sauna zone with soothing panoramic relaxation lounges
kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen offers exhilarating water fun with giant slides, a wave pool, and a large sauna landscape.
beschreibung:
Water Action and Wellness in the Zillertal

The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen is a popular attraction for water enthusiasts and wellness seekers in the Zillertal. The thermal spa excels with a harmonious blend of exhilarating adventure pools and restorative relaxation zones.

Waves, Slides, and Relaxation

Key highlights include the wave pool with surging breakers and the 133-metre-long adventure slide featuring spectacular light effects. In the pleasantly warm outdoor brine pool, guests can take in views of the Zillertal mountain landscape, while the spacious sauna area with its diverse saunas invites total relaxation.
